profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.geoLocationName: Blue Point, New York, United States
profile.summary: An experienced, ambitious and determined software engineer, and computer science graduate of Stony Brook University. Currently  looking to advance his career in software.

positions.title: Software Engineeer
positions.description:
Worked as software engineer for Communications and Radar divisions of Telephonics. 

● Performed all phases of software development of the FAA DO-178 Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for aircraft crew communications systems.
● Wrote Real Time embedded applications in C++, running under DOS.
● Produced and reviewed design, code and tests as member of the Systems and Software engineering
team. Projects included communications system for Air Force One and several military programs.
● Established traceability between requirements, design and testing using IBM Rational DOORS.
● Developed C++ code using Microsoft Visual Studio.
● Worked on the company Remote Monitoring Tool, a Windows based tool which provides visibility into
operation of the embedded processors in radar systems.
● Developed design artifacts using Enterprise Architect (IBM).
● Installed embedded radar applications in UNIX based systems mounted on border support vehicles.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Developed and debugged (in a SCRUM and AGILE environment) full-stack MVVM ASP.NET software
applications for electronic tolling software on large scale projects.
● Implemented code using C#, XAML, and SQL.
● Used Visual Studio, Microsoft SQL Server, and Microsoft SQL Server Profiler.
● Implemented fixes and advancements to SQL stored procedures, functions, views, as well as front and
back end Views and ViewModel code.
● Designed and scripted automated testing framework using third party technology and C# from ground
up.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Participated in requirements analysis, design and coding of a Windows based testing environment for a
large IFF radar software system targeted to a multi core Single Board Computer running VxWorks OS.
● Coded test environment in C++ using Visual C++.
● Used the Waterfall development paradigm from requirements through design, coding and test including
peer reviews.

honors.title: Eagle Scout of Boy Scouts of America
honors.description:
I was awarded the rank of Eagle after my many years being involved in Boy Scouts.
The project I had planned and executed as requirement was a sprinkler system near a public baseball field.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 2010

volunteerExperiences.description: As a boy scout of Troop 130, I took part in many volunteer projects for the church we held our meetings, and the many Eagle Scout projects conducted including my own.
